'''Iván Rodríguez Martos''' (born 7 June 2006) is a professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[left-back]] for Spanish club [[SD Huesca]], on loan from [[FC Andorra]]. Born in Spain, he represents Andorra at youth international level.

==Club career==
Born in [[Santpedor]], [[Province of Barcelona|Barcelona]], [[Catalonia]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://naciodigital.cat/manresa/esports/santpedor-premia-els-joves-david-orrit-ivan-rodriguez-i-maria-costa-en-la-nit-de-lesport.html|title=Santpedor premia els joves David Òrrit, Ivan Rodríguez i Maria Costa en la nit de l'esport|trans-title=Santpedor award the youngsters David Òrrit, Ivan Rodríguez and Maria Costa in the sports night|publisher=Naciò Manresa|language=ca|date=14 July 2018|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref> Rodríguez joined [[FC Barcelona]]'s [[La Masia]] in 2016, after representing [[Club Gimnàstic de Manresa]] and hometown side CF Santpedor.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://futbolbasecatala.cat/es/plantilla-barca/ivan-rodriguez-martos:27-1195|title=Ivan Rodriguez Martos|publisher=Futbol Base Catalá|language=es|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref> He left the club in 2019, and returned to ''Nàstic'' Manresa, now an affiliate side of [[FC Andorra]].

In August 2024, after playing in the pre-season with Andorra, Rodríguez was promoted to the first team by manager [[Ferran Costa]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/ivan-rodriguez-first-team|title=Iván Rodríguez will train with the first team during the season|publisher=FC Andorra|date=19 August 2024|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rtva.ad/ca/esports/futbol/ivan-rodriguez-bilal-achhiba-convencen-ferran|title=Iván Rodríguez i Bilal Achhiba convencen Ferran Costa|trans-title=Iván Rodríguez and Bilal Achhiba convince Ferran Costa|publisher=[[Radio and Television of Andorra]]|language=ca|date=20 August 2024|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref> He made his league debut on 21 September 2024, starting in a 1–0 [[Primera Federación]] away win over [[Sestao River Club]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/ivan-rodriguez-i-bomba-debuten-en-lliga-amb-l-fc-andorra|title=Iván Rodríguez i ‘Bomba’ debuten en lliga amb l’FC Andorra|trans-title=Iván Rodríguez and 'Bomba' debut in the league with FC Andorra|publisher=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]]|language=ca|date=25 September 2024|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref>

On 8 October 2024, Rodríguez renewed his contract with the ''Tricolors'' until 2027.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/ivan-rodriguez-2027|title=Iván Rodríguez, tricolour until 2027|publisher=FC Andorra|date=8 October 2024|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref> He established himself as a first-choice during [[2024–25 Primera Federación|the season]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bondia.ad/esports/ivan-rodriguez-beto-confia-molt-en-mi|title=Iván Rodríguez: “‘Beto’ confia molt en mi”|trans-title=Iván Rodríguez: "Beto trusts in me a lot"|publisher=[[Bondia (newspaper)|Bondia]]|language=ca|date=20 March 2025|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://elperiodic.ad/esports/els-inicis-dels-partits-fora-de-casa-la-clau-que-necessita-millorar-lfc-andorra-per-accedir-al-play-off/|title=Els inicis dels partits fora de casa, la clau que necessita millorar l’FC Andorra per accedir al play-off|trans-title=The start of the away matches, the key which FC Andorra needs improving to reach the play-offs|publisher=[[El Periòdic d'Andorra]]|language=ca|date=19 March 2025|accessdate=17 July 2025}}</ref> contributing with 34 appearances overall as the club achieved promotion to [[Segunda División]].

On 6 August 2025, Rodríguez was loaned to [[Villarreal CF B]] in the third division, for one year.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/noticies/ivan-rodriguez-cedit|title=Acord amb el Villarreal per Iván Rodríguez|trans-title=Agreement with Villarreal for Iván Rodríguez|publisher=FC Andorra|language=ca|date=6 August 2025|accessdate=7 August 2025}}</ref> The following 8 July, he moved to fellow league team [[SD Huesca]] also in a temporary deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/loan-ivan-rodriguez-huesca|title=Agreement with Huesca for the loan of Iván Rodríguez|publisher=FC Andorra|date=8 July 2026|accessdate=11 July 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
Born in Spain, Rodríguez represented [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] at [[Andorra national under-17 football team|under-17]] and [[Andorra national under-19 football team|under-19]] levels.
